name: eval02_科学展
desc: 校园故事（中词）：that/who 定从、被动密集（含引语内被动豁免控制句）、过去完成、THAT_EXEMPT 宾从控制句

passive: Every class was asked to bring one project, and the best one would win a new set of books.
Our robot was called Little Star, and it could find a black line on white paper.
The little motor was joined to the wheels with thin wire, and a small battery gave power to the whole system.
On the morning of the fair, the hall was filled with noisy students and bright posters.
In the end we were given a small prize for the most honest project.
relcl: A light that flashed red and green sat on its head like a small hat.
Lin, who was better at drawing than me, painted a silver star on its back.
A robot that moved across the table by itself won the loudest cheers from all the younger students near the door.
pastperf: My friend Lin and I had worked on a small robot for three whole weeks.
We had built it out of an old toy car and some cheap parts from a night market.
Before the fair I had never spoken to so many people in one day.
By noon the judges had finished half of the tables.
overlong: The little motor was joined to the wheels with thin wire, and a small battery gave power to the whole system.
A robot that moved across the table by itself won the loudest cheers from all the younger students near the door.
